title: Refusal Before Decoding: Detecting and Exploiting Refusal Signals in Intermediate LLM Activations
abstract: arXiv:2605.28553v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In this paper, we investigate whether refusal behavior can be predicted from LLM intermediate activations before decoding using linear probes trained on residual stream activations at each transformer block. We find that refusal is linearly decodable well before the final layer, indicating that safety-relevant behavior is represented in intermediate activations before output generation. To test whether this signal is actionable, we introduce Mechanistic AutoDAN, a probe-guided variant of AutoDAN that replaces full-model fitness evaluation with partial forward passes and probe-based scoring inside a genetic prompt search loop. Across the evaluated models, our method achieves attack success rates competitive with vanilla AutoDAN while reducing per-iteration search time by up to 72%, and probe-guided prompts match or exceed AutoDAN's cross-model transfer in several configurations. translated_title: 解码前的拒绝行为：检测并利用大语言模型中间激活中的拒绝信号
translated_abstract: 本文研究了能否在解码之前，利用在每个Transformer块残差流激活上训练的线性探针，从大语言模型的中间激活中预测拒绝行为。我们发现拒绝行为在远早于最后一层的层级即可被线性解码，这表明与安全相关的行为在输出生成之前就已体现在中间激活中。为了测试这一信号是否具有可操作性，我们提出了Mechanistic AutoDAN，这是AutoDAN的一种探针引导变体，它在遗传提示搜索循环中用部分前向传播和基于探针的评分替代了全模型适应度评估。在所评估的各个模型上，我们的方法实现了与原始AutoDAN相当的攻击成功率，同时将每次迭代的搜索时间最多减少72%，并且在若干配置下，探针引导的提示词在跨模型迁移方面达到甚至超过了AutoDAN的水平。我们进一步发现探针引导在……
tldr: 大语言模型的拒绝行为在中间激活层就已线性可解码，利用这一信号构建的探针引导攻击方法Mechanistic AutoDAN能在保持相当攻击成功率的同时，将越狱攻击的搜索时间最多减少72%。
en_tdlr: LLM refusal behavior is linearly decodable from intermediate activations well before the final layer, and exploiting this signal via probe-guided Mechanistic AutoDAN cuts attack search time by up to 72% while maintaining attack success rates comparable to vanilla AutoDAN.
